scope.runtime_evidence: No positive Cell-stage or function-level runtime trace is present. Historical startup evidence is not used as gameplay evidence.
scope.scope_rule: Entity/object claims require binary, SDK, structural, or independently reproduced current-source evidence. SDK/community names without binary evidence remain name-level or unknown.

evidence_summary.claim: Cell gameplay has a state spine centered on sCellGame/cCellGame, a 4096-element cObjectPool<cCellObjectData>, spatial query pools, cCellGFX presentation state, and cCellUI state.
The main cell object is a 920-byte gameplay/graphics/animation record, but only a bounded subset of its fields and side effects is characterized.
Creature, city, tribe, tool, and editor-model families are name- and vtable-anchored but not a single proven entity/component architecture.
The strongest reconstruction value is in stable handles, pool identity, ownership boundaries, lifecycle ordering, content references, and selected pure rules; original runtime fidelity remains open.

types.name: Simulator::Cell::sCellGame / cCellGame
types.claim: A 20,964-byte global Cell-mode state object holds the main cell pool, query references, world references, avatar pool index, timing/flags, serializable state, and late mode/update fields.
types.limits: The full layout and semantics of many late fields are not established; current CellGame is a named logical projection, not a byte-complete replacement.

types.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellObjectData
types.claim: A 920-byte pooled per-cell record carries pool identity, idle state, target/current transform data, opacity/size, model/resource identity, animation, flee/chase, health, GFX, scale, and query ownership fields.
types.limits: The current C++ re-layout preserves selected offsets and 920-byte size but leaves the remainder opaque; AI, damage, power, projectile, and lifecycle ownership remain partial.

types.name: cObjectPool<cCellObjectData>
types.claim: The main Cell pool is a 28-byte metadata pool with a contiguous 920-byte element buffer, free-list head, capacity, live count, stride, and 4,096-element capacity in cCellGame::Initialize.
types.limits: Generic cObjectPool_ SDK name/body identity is contradicted in one decomp-gap record; Cell-specific capacity and free-list shape are stronger.

types.name: cCellQueryEntry / cCellQueryLinkedPool / cCellQueryLinkedPoolData
types.claim: The Cell query family stores position, size, next links, and cell pool indices and is exposed as foreground/background spatial candidate state.
types.limits: Near predicate is reconstructed; insertion, removal, partition, and traversal order are not.

types.name: cCellDataReference
types.claim: Cell world references are carried by a small Cell data-reference object used by current/background world state; the adjacent creation address is unresolved.
types.limits: 0x00e82340 and SDK-associated 0x00e82420 must remain separate; current CellDataReference is an id-only projection.

types.name: cCellSerializableData
types.claim: A serializable-data object is reached from cCellGame and is used as a save/load or runtime-state boundary.
types.limits: Complete field schema, save/load coverage, and round-trip order are unknown.

types.name: cCellCellResource / cCellWorldResource / cCellPopulateResource
types.claim: Typed Cell records encode cell definitions, world/advection data, and population markers used as inputs to Cell state and presentation.
types.limits: Record decoding and hard-reference validation are strong; runtime selection, placement, and behavior remain unresolved.

types.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellGFX
types.claim: The Cell GFX singleton owns render-world/layer handles, effect slots, preload records, and display state for the Cell stage.
types.limits: World IDs and ordering are strong; RenderWare ownership, material behavior, and live handle lifetime are outside the current projection.

types.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellUI / cCellUIRollover
types.claim: The 2,372-byte Cell UI object carries world/background vectors, layout/zoom, selection state, and rollover-pool state; rollover records carry health feedback and a disappearance timer.
types.limits: Only a bounded HUD projection is current; full UI graph and event transport are unresolved.

types.name: App::cCellModeStrategy
types.claim: A 27-slot mode object provides Cell Initialize/Dispose/OnEnter/OnExit/input/update dispatch and coordinates CellGame, CellGFX, and CellUI singletons.
types.limits: The base class and complete vtable hierarchy are not established; current IGameMode is a host-side comparison.

types.name: Simulator::cGameInputManager
types.claim: A 276-byte input manager with a 27-slot vtable tracks last/current modes, maps, mouse state, input regions, strings, a vector, and an integer field.
types.limits: Named accessor and field map are strong; routing algorithm and ownership are not reconstructed.

types.name: Graphics::Model / cModelObject
types.claim: SDK and targeted decompilation evidence associate a Graphics::Model or cModelObject-like object with model state; one targeted body copies owner+0x780..0x78c to caller outputs, without proving a common class layout.
types.limits: Do not promote the community/decompiler name to a proven C++ type; current GmdlModel is only a host-side value object.

types.name: AnimatedCreature / IAnimWorld / EditorCreatureController
types.claim: SDK field/vtable evidence links AnimatedCreature, IAnimWorld, and EditorCreatureController through position/orientation, model, animation ID, target/current angle, movement-speed, rotation-speed, and world-update interfaces.
types.limits: No complete pose/animation implementation, concrete implementation identity, or runtime ownership is established.

types.name: AnimationMessage
types.claim: A message record carries message ID, name, AnimatedCreature pointer, block index, integer parameter, and float parameter across the animation dispatch boundary.
types.limits: Message IDs, queue order, and runtime send/post behavior are unresolved.

types.name: Simulator::cCreatureBase / cCreatureGameData / cCreatureAnimal
types.claim: SDK/vtable-attributed functions cover creature ability lookup, target selection, animation, effect pools, walking, voice, creation, and avatar/NPC AI ticks.
types.limits: Most bodies are not persisted; vtable/name association does not establish a complete class layout or hierarchy.

types.name: Simulator::cCity
types.claim: SDK-attributed city functions cover above-city tests, vehicle spawning, building add/remove/update, and city state operations.
types.limits: No current implementation, runtime trace, or complete city entity graph is available.

types.name: cTribe
types.claim: A 6,624-byte cTribe object is read for int3 position data in the space event-record builder, proving a cross-mode state reference but not a complete tribe object model.
types.limits: The dossier's cTribe name and offsets are structural/decompiler evidence; broader ownership and lifecycle are unknown.

types.name: Simulator::cGameData / cEmpire
types.claim: cGameData exposes owner/serialization/write operations; cEmpire is a 344-byte identity object with political ID +0x84 reached through a lazy cache and cStarManager map.
types.limits: cGameData schema and cross-stage handoffs are unresolved; full cEmpire ownership and dynamic subtype are not reconstructed.

types.name: Simulator::cToolStrategy variants
types.claim: A vtable-attributed tool family spans cDefaultAoETool, cDefaultBeamTool, and cGetOutOfUFOToolStrategy selection/input/virtual operations.
types.limits: The tool hierarchy and actor ownership are not fully mapped; names are SDK/vtable anchors, not behavioral contracts.

types.name: Editors::EditorModel
types.claim: EditorModel has a large vtable family with SetColor at 0x004ae250 and associated model/name/load/dispose state operations.
types.limits: The vtable scan has no MSVC RTTI and family membership is name-level/structural; no current implementation.

types.name: Simulator::cObjectPool_
types.claim: Generic cObjectPool_ functions named Initialize, CreateObject, Get, and DeleteObject form a cross-domain pool family, but one targeted decompilation conflicts with the SDK Initialize identity.
types.limits: Do not generalize the Cell-specific pool ABI to all cObjectPool_ uses until the address/name contradiction is resolved.

types.name: 0x0F43029A world-object model-group record
types.kind: asset record, not proven C++ entity
types.claim: A 20-byte-header model-group record with magic, version, three counts, part-name strings, vector values, and complete byte accounting is observed across 1,365 records; it is not CellSerializer content.
types.limits: Field order inside primary entries and runtime ownership/placement are unresolved; do not call it a proven original class.

types.name: GmdlModel / Mesh / SceneEntity / openspore::sim::Entity
types.claim: Current source has separate bounded GMDL/model, host mesh, scene description, and deterministic entity value objects; these are comparison surfaces, not original runtime object claims.
types.limits: Current positions, player identity, role strings, food/prey rules, and event types are not original ABI/runtime evidence.

semantic_subsystem.name: Cell state and entity spine
semantic_subsystem.claim: The stable gameplay spine is CellGame -> main object pool -> cCellObjectData, with avatar index and query references providing identity.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Expose handles/indices and typed state, not original offsets or global singletons.
semantic_subsystem.limits: Full cCellObjectData semantics and original frame orchestration remain open.

semantic_subsystem.name: Cell content and world population
semantic_subsystem.claim: Typed Cell records are validated content inputs; they are not by themselves evidence of runtime placement or AI execution.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Keep record identity/decoding separate from runtime selection and action.
semantic_subsystem.limits: World/populate execution and player identity remain unresolved.

semantic_subsystem.name: Cell presentation and UI ownership
semantic_subsystem.claim: CellGFX and CellUI are coordinated presentation/UI singletons referenced by the mode lifecycle, with explicit world/effect/health-feedback paths.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Preserve world/resource association and ordering; replace RenderWare/UI implementation details.
semantic_subsystem.limits: Original handle lifetime, materials, HUD timing, and UI graph are unresolved.

semantic_subsystem.name: Shared Simulator ownership
semantic_subsystem.claim: High-fan-in Simulator accessors provide service, input, empire, noun, and object lookup handles, but unnamed roots must remain type-open.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Freeze accessor contracts before implementing dependents; never infer a concrete service from fan-in.
semantic_subsystem.limits: Unnamed roots, allocator relationships, exact pointee types, and vtable identities remain unknown.

semantic_subsystem.name: Creature/city/tribe object families
semantic_subsystem.claim: Creature, city, and tribe families are independent SDK/structural anchors with cross-stage consumers, not a proven unified component model.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Keep stage-specific entity families separate until owner, creation, deletion, and event paths are correlated.
semantic_subsystem.limits: No runtime stage trace, complete layouts, or proven cross-stage identity.

semantic_subsystem.name: Animation and model component boundary
semantic_subsystem.claim: AnimatedCreature/IAnimWorld/EditorCreatureController establish a separate animation/model boundary, while cModelObject/Graphics::Model identities remain unresolved.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Preserve typed animation/message relations; do not infer a common Graphics::Model ABI from names.
semantic_subsystem.limits: No complete pose/skeleton stream, message IDs, or current OpenSpore counterpart.

semantic_subsystem.name: Tool/editor component families
semantic_subsystem.claim: Tool strategies and EditorModel are vtable-attached gameplay/editor components, but their exact hierarchy and event contracts are not established.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Preserve dispatch roles and ownership questions; do not promote a complete component architecture.
semantic_subsystem.limits: No runtime trace; vtable family membership is structural/name-level.

semantic_subsystem.name: Serialization and event records
semantic_subsystem.claim: Serialization is distributed across cCellSerializableData, cGameData, property/event records, and mode-specific event builders; no universal event record is proven.
semantic_subsystem.boundary: Preserve record identity and ordering when known; do not flatten records into SimEvent as an original ABI claim.
semantic_subsystem.limits: Field schemas, versions, save/load coverage, and event transport are unresolved.
